Privacy & Data Policy

Last updated: 2026-09-11

Data We Collect

This directory publishes publicly available business information sourced from Scraped from Google Business Profiles (September 2024). This includes business names, addresses, phone numbers, websites, operating hours, categories, and aggregate rating data from public review platforms.

We do not collect personal information from visitors unless you voluntarily contact us through our contact form. Any information you submit through that form is used solely to respond to your inquiry.

How We Use Your Data

Business listing data is used to:

  • Display retreat information in our directory
  • Sort listings using our Bayesian ranking methodology
  • Provide city and service category browsing
  • Generate sitemaps for search engine indexing

We do not sell, rent, or share business data with third parties for marketing purposes. Contact form submissions are used only to respond to your request.

Data Removal Requests

If you are a business owner or authorized representative and would like your listing removed from this directory, we honor removal requests within 48 hours. To request removal:

  1. Visit our contact page
  2. Select "Data Removal Request" as the subject
  3. Include the business name and city in your message

We verify ownership by checking the email domain against the business's listed website. Removal requests from free email providers (Gmail, Yahoo, etc.) may require additional verification.

Cookies & Tracking

This site does not set tracking cookies. We do not use analytics services that collect personally identifiable information. Any server logs are standard hosting logs used only for site security and uptime monitoring.

Third-Party Links

Listing profiles may link to external business websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external sites. We recommend reviewing the privacy policy of any website you visit.

Featured Placement Disclosure

Some listings may be marked as "Featured" when a business pays for premium placement. Featured listings are always clearly labeled. Paid placement does not affect displayed ratings or review counts, which reflect public data without modification.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of this site after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

Contact

Questions about this privacy policy? Contact us and we'll respond within 48 hours.
